POL-OUTAGE-CREDIT.rule: For confirmed outages (active or historical) affecting a customer's region, apply credit of $10 per documented outage day, up to $50 maximum. For active outages with ongoing impact, prorate based on expected restoration ETA (default minimum 1 day = $10). Customer's verbal claim alone is not sufficient; outage must be present in check_active_incidents (current or historical).

POL-OUTAGE-COMMUNICATION.rule: When deferring to active outage status, send case number, current restoration ETA, and status page link via send_message. Do not walk the customer through troubleshooting when an active incident is already identified in their region.

POL-CANCELLATION.rule: Process cancellation requests cleanly. For customers with 12+ months tenure, present POL-LOYALTY-DISCOUNT as an alternative neutrally alongside the cancellation path. Do not pressure-retain. If customer chooses cancellation, schedule_callback to retention_specialist for confirmation and offboarding.

POL-LOYALTY-DISCOUNT.rule: Customers with 12+ months tenure are eligible for a $20/month discount for 6 months. Agent may present this option alongside cancellation. Customer must explicitly accept; agent does not apply unilaterally. Discount applies via recurring apply_credit (monthly).
